settings.heading: Thoughtfully designed for every walk.
settings.description: We believe the things we buy for our dogs should be just as thoughtfully designed as the things we buy for ourselves — beautifully crafted, built to last, and rooted in purpose.

settings.title: Comfort First
settings.description: Soft neoprene and breathable mesh designed for everyday comfort.
settings.extra_text: Padded contact points and flexible seams prevent chafing on long walks.

settings.title: Thoughtful Design
settings.description: Adjustable details and coordinated pieces made for effortless walks.
settings.extra_text: Every colourway is designed to mix and match across the collection.

settings.title: Made to Last
settings.description: Durable materials and dependable hardware chosen for everyday adventures.
settings.extra_text: Reinforced stitching and corrosion-resistant clips, tested season after season.
